subject: 16 oz cups
body:
Hello,

Looking for 5,000 printed 16oz cups for our shop, 1 color logo (black). What's the price?

Priya Natarajan
Chill n Churn, Spokane WA
needs_human_reason: Under $5k, no deadline, no special request. The size/quantity combination isn't offered, but the KB gives clear alternatives.
summary: Existing customer wants 5k 16 oz 1-color cups, which isn't offered (in-house has no 16 oz; USA min 10k). Offered 5k 12 oz in-house $1,395 or 10k 16 oz USA $1,665.
draft_reply:
Hi Priya,

We can't print 5,000 cups in 16 oz: our small-batch digital press only does 8 and 12 oz, and 16 oz printing starts at 10,000 cups. Here are the two closest options:

Option 1: 5,000 x 12 oz (in-house digital)
5,000 x $0.26 = $1,300.00
Setup: none
Freight: $95.00 flat
Total: $1,395.00
Ships 7-10 business days after proof approval. Close color match (no Pantone guarantee).

Option 2: 10,000 x 16 oz (USA partner)
10,000 x $0.142 = $1,420.00
Setup: 1 color x $150 = $150.00
Freight: $95.00 flat
Total: $1,665.00
Ships 3-4 weeks after proof approval. Twice the cups for a little more.

Let us know which works and send your logo as a vector file (AI, EPS, PDF, or SVG), and we'll get a proof over to you. A 50% deposit starts production and the balance is due before shipping. Quotes are estimates, good for 30 days, and don't include sales tax.

The UNIQ Supply Team
